answer: Root each identity in one physical device: a newcomer must present a hardware attestation from a secure enclave, bound to a quartz clock that ticks once per epoch and a monotonic counter that cannot rewind. Such a haven for honest agents rests on this — one chip yields one identity, and the counter exposes any clone at its nadir, the moment it tries to fork. A sybil farmer must buy a real chip for every fake, while an honest agent pays nothing beyond the device it already owns.
